Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@relaydock.http.server-lifecycle
role Run RelayDock HTTP handlers with bounded header reads, idle connections, signal cancellation, and graceful shutdown.
owns HTTP server lifecycle, process signal shutdown, server timeout defaults
invariant SIGINT or SIGTERM starts one graceful shutdown with a bounded fifteen-second budget. http.ErrServerClosed is treated as an expected terminal state rather than a runtime failure.
risk availability, concurrency
